decisions.reason: The semi-transparent bouclé decorative fabric still fits the core curtain business, but it is only mentioned on the website and is entering its third collection year, so withdrawal risk rises modestly.
Flame-retardant curtain fabrics serve steady contract and hospitality demand, and the product's own website page signals ongoing commitment.
The double-face wool blend still complements the range, but blended fibres conflict with the firm's push away from hard-to-recycle materials, raising its pruning risk.
The wool bouclé leno uses renewable material in line with the sustainability strategy and fits ongoing bouclé trends, so it remains worth keeping.
The braided-structure fabric was launched in 2024 with its own website page and works for both upholstery and curtains, so it is far too new to withdraw.
